reasoning_summary: Two-level directory bit vector gives O(1) rank and O(log n) select; a wavelet matrix built from stable partitions of that vector answers access/rank/select/kth/range-count in O(log sigma) rank calls; Elias-Fano splits values at floor(log2(u/n)) and uses select0 to jump to a bucket for successor search. Verified by literal tests, boundary sizes, seeded differential tests, corruption tests and an 18-mutant pass.
